Overview

Tacna is a city in TA with a population of 300,000. A southern border city near Chile, known for its patriotic history and duty-free shopping. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
